SELECT
  store_name AS store,
  close_date AS when_it_closed
FROM contoso_served.dim_store
WHERE
  NOT close_date IS NULL AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM close_date) > 2018
ORDER BY
  close_date,
  store_name
